quests.title: A Report for the March
quests.description: Deathguard Lyle has watched the south road from the gate for months. He has a short, grim report for Sergeant Dallow at Valgan's Field and no one to send. He would very much like it to arrive without having been read.

objectives.label: Deliver the scout's report to Sergeant Dallow at Valgan's Field

quests.accept_text: South along the trunk road. The field camp is under the banners, past the crossroad. Dallow will take it from you.
quests.turn_in_text: Lyle always did write short. Two lines, a smudge, and a warning. I'll make something of it.

on_accept.name: Lyle's Scout Report
on_accept.description: A single folded page, sealed with a drop of black wax.

quests.title: Clear the March
quests.description: The March exists to keep the road to Ambermill open, and the road is full of wolves and the leavings of bears that died of something the Apothecaries haven't named. Dallow wants both thinned before the next supply train.
quests.accept_text: Anywhere in the pines south of the gate. Wolves and bears. If it's limping and drooling, it's the one.
quests.turn_in_text: Quieter roads, fewer drovers screaming. You're a credit to the March.

quests.title: Walk-Aways
quests.description: Some of the March did not stay. A few dozen Forsaken, tired of orders, walked off Valgan's Field and set up as brigands on the farm. Dallow takes this personally, as the walking-off was done under his nose.
quests.accept_text: Valgan's Field, the ruined farm around my camp. They wear March coats with the insignia torn off.
quests.turn_in_text: I'd hoped they'd come back on their own. They didn't. Thank you for doing what I couldn't.

quests.title: Dog Tags
quests.description: Every March soldier is issued an iron tag, stamped with a number. Dallow keeps the roll, and wants the tags of the deserters, so that when someone else asks who left, he can say who and by what number.
quests.accept_text: Off the bodies of the deserters. Iron tags on a cord. Six of them.
quests.turn_in_text: Six names off the roll. They'll be remembered, though perhaps not kindly.

quests.title: The Letter in the Pocket
quests.description: A letter, taken from a dead deserter's pocket, addressed to someone in the Undercity. The seal is unbroken. Whatever it says, someone in the March ought to read it before it's posted.

objectives.label: Bring the letter to Sergeant Dallow

quests.accept_text: Dallow, at Valgan's Field. He will want to know who the deserters were writing to.
quests.turn_in_text: A mother, in Brill. The man was nineteen. Gods. I'll see she's told the right way.

quests.title: Bones for the Surgeon
quests.description: Field Surgeon Ashe has run out of replacement bone. The battlefield wights of Valgan's Field wear the bones of better men, and she is not too proud to recycle them.
quests.accept_text: The wights on the field. Take the long bones - arms and legs. Cleaned, if you can.
quests.turn_in_text: These'll do. Slightly used, slightly regretful. Thank you.

quests.title: The Captain Who Never Stopped
quests.description: A Deathguard Captain has been fighting the Third War on Valgan's Field since before Dallow arrived. He does not answer to orders, rank, or reason, and the March cannot hold the field while he walks it.
quests.accept_text: Deep in the field, where the wights gather. He's the one still giving commands.
quests.turn_in_text: He was a good officer once. The best of us, maybe. Thank you for ending the watch.

quests.title: Pelts for the Hunter
quests.description: The Forsaken Hunter wants six clean wolf pelts. 'Diseased' is fine; 'dissolving' is not. He's making a cloak for someone he used to know, and refuses to say who.
quests.accept_text: The diseased wolves along the road. Skin them carefully. The cloak is a gift.
quests.turn_in_text: Good work. A bit mangy, but a cloak that's been through something is worth more.

quests.title: Carrion Calls
quests.description: The carrion birds have been following the Hunter's traps and stealing the kills. He doesn't mind sharing, much. He minds the birds taking the traps.
quests.accept_text: Anywhere in the pines. They're bold. Show them what boldness gets.
quests.turn_in_text: That'll teach them manners. Doubt it, but it's a start.

quests.title: The Hogs Went First
quests.description: The Bucklebree hogs went wrong the same week the plague reached the farm. They still root in the dirt, but what they root up is worse. Farmer Bucklebree wants the herd put down before it breeds.
quests.accept_text: The pens and the barn. The hogs won't run. The ghouls will, and then come back.
quests.turn_in_text: It's quiet on the farm for the first time in months. Odd how much I miss the noise.

quests.title: The Missing Quilts
quests.description: Merriam sewed a quilt for every child born on the farm. The barn ghouls drag them off and sleep on them. She wants six scraps back, to piece together whatever's left of the family.
quests.accept_text: The barn ghouls. They keep the scraps tucked into their rags.
quests.turn_in_text: That's the blue one. That's my mother's stitching. Thank you. Thank you.

quests.title: Tusk-Mother Gorra
quests.description: The old sow of the Bucklebree herd was the biggest hog in Silverpine. She did not die with the others. She grew. Bucklebree has a knife, and no stomach to use it.
quests.accept_text: In the east field, past the fence. You'll hear her before you see her.
quests.turn_in_text: She nursed forty litters. She was a good mother, in her way. Thank you.

quests.title: What Moves in the Water
quests.description: Marshwalker Thorne has walked the edge of Olivia's Pond for two years, and for the last three weeks something has walked it with him. Marsh oozes, swamp ghouls, bloated things. He'd like fewer companions.
quests.accept_text: Around the pond. The oozes hug the shore. The ghouls come out at dusk.
quests.turn_in_text: A little quieter. A little less of me sinking in the mud. Thank you.

quests.title: The Pond's Edge
quests.description: Thorne wants someone to circle the pond on foot and tell him what's changed. He has a theory about where the water is going, and a stronger theory about where it's coming from.
quests.accept_text: Three points: the east bank, the south bank, the south-west reeds. Count the dead fish. If there are none, run.
quests.turn_in_text: No fish at all. That's the answer I was afraid of.

quests.title: Gas from the Bloated
quests.description: The bloated corpses of the pond carry bladders of marsh gas, and Thorne wants five, sealed, to test. He claims the gas is the source of the oozes. It has a simple remedy: stop it at the source.
quests.accept_text: The bloated corpses, by the south bank. Pierce them carefully. Do not breathe.
quests.turn_in_text: That smell is worse than I'd hoped. That's how I know it's the right stuff.

quests.title: The Bloated One
quests.description: At the pond's heart lies a corpse so swollen it can no longer rise. It lashes at anything that comes near, and what it bursts into is worse than what it was. Thorne has finally found the source.
quests.accept_text: The middle of the pond, up to your ankles in muck. Strike and step back. Strike and step back.
quests.turn_in_text: It's burst, and it's done. I'll wash for a week. Thank you.

quests.title: Kobolds in the Gallery
quests.description: Overseer Hobart held the Deep Elem Mine through the plague, the Scourge and the second strike. The kobolds that moved in after the collapse have moved in for good. He wants the gallery cleared, and he wants to see them go first.
quests.accept_text: At the mine mouth and the old galleries. Kobolds, rotting and digging. Both bite.
quests.turn_in_text: That's a clear gallery. I can almost smell the ore again.

quests.title: Lamps in the Dark
quests.description: Shamblers of dead miners still walk Deep Elem's galleries, carrying the lamps they died with. Hobart wants six. 'They belonged to the company,' he says, a little too firmly.
quests.accept_text: The shamblers at the mine mouth. Take the lamps from their hands. Mind the oil.
quests.turn_in_text: Six lamps, six names. The company will be pleased. I can stop pretending there's a company.

quests.title: The Collapsed Gallery
quests.description: The main gallery collapsed the day of the plague, and Hobart has never been back to look. He wants someone to stand at its mouth, and tell him whether the supports held.
quests.accept_text: The mine mouth to the west. Don't go in. Stand at the threshold, and tell me what you see.
quests.turn_in_text: Supports gone. Ore everywhere. And the foreman's lamp, still lit. I knew it.

quests.title: Gnawbone the Foreman
quests.description: Gnawbone was the kobold foreman of Deep Elem, and the only one that kept his job after the collapse. He wears the company's hard-hat and gives orders in a tongue Hobart half-remembers. He has to go.
quests.accept_text: Deep in the mine, among the carts. He's the one with the bone pick and the helmet.
quests.turn_in_text: My old foreman's helmet... on a kobold. I'll take it back. Thank you.

quests.title: The Pyrewood Ambush
quests.description: The worgen of Pyrewood Village were people once, and ambush from the treeline is still how they hunt. Hearthwarden Brand wants the ambushers and the ferals thinned before the dead come to the village next.
quests.accept_text: The village streets and the treeline. They hunt in packs. Don't be alone.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer fangs in the dark. I'll almost let myself breathe.

quests.title: The Ashen Cult
quests.description: A cult has taken up in Pyrewood's burned houses, casting spells over the dead hearths. Brand does not know which god they pray to. He knows it answers.
quests.accept_text: The burned houses on the east side. They chant. They don't stop for you.
quests.turn_in_text: Quiet at last. Whatever answered them has gone quiet too.

quests.title: The Cult's Sigils
quests.description: Each cultist carries an iron sigil, stamped with a cipher Brand doesn't recognise. He wants five, for a scholar in the Undercity who might.
quests.accept_text: From the cultists. Iron discs on cords. Don't read the cipher aloud.
quests.turn_in_text: I'll have them sent to Sennarath in the Undercity. If anyone can read them, she can.

quests.title: The Hall at the Heart
quests.description: Pyrewood Hall stands at the north end of the village, its roof half-gone and its doors barred from the inside. Brand wants someone to stand at its steps and tell him what's behind them.
quests.accept_text: The Hall, at the north end of the green. Don't go in. Look at the doors.
quests.turn_in_text: Barred from the inside, as I feared. Whatever's in there wants to stay.

quests.title: Lord Godfrey's Remnant
quests.description: What stands in Pyrewood Hall is what the lord of the village left behind: a ghost in a noble's coat, pistol in one hand and cane in the other, still giving the dead orders.
quests.accept_text: Inside the Hall. Mind the pistol. It never misses, and it never reloads.
quests.turn_in_text: He was a decent man, once. Not a good one. A decent one. That's more than most. Thank you.

quests.title: Stalkers on the Hill
quests.description: Berard's Talon is a ridge of broken stone above the old keep road. Crag stalkers hunt its slopes, and wraiths drift along its crest. Trapper Hask wants both cleared, so he can finally set his lines.
quests.accept_text: The hill west of the keep road. Stalkers on the rocks, wraiths on the crest.
quests.turn_in_text: The lines can go out tonight. Thank you.

quests.title: Grave-Tokens
quests.description: The wraiths of Berard's Talon carry small tokens of the dead - coins, buttons, rings - clutched in spectral fingers. Hask wants five, and plans to return them to the graves they came from.
quests.accept_text: Off the wraiths. Don't hold them too long. They remember.
quests.turn_in_text: Five graves to visit. It'll take all winter. Good. I'm not in a hurry.

quests.title: Berard the Forgotten
quests.description: The hill is named for Berard, a man whose face no longer appears in any record. He walks the ridge each night and no one remembers what he is looking for.
quests.accept_text: On the crest, under the old stone ring. He moves like a man trying to remember.
quests.turn_in_text: Maybe he'll rest now. Maybe someone will remember his face. Thank you.

quests.title: Break the Pack
quests.description: A worgen pack has dug in under the hills of Beren's Peril, led by packmasters who've learned to hold a line. Packbreaker Rynn wants the line broken, and the stalkers that run in front of it.
quests.accept_text: The hills south-east of Pyrewood. They hold the high ground. Don't give them the high ground.
quests.turn_in_text: That's the pack broken. A good start. The alpha next.

quests.title: Teeth of the Packmasters
quests.description: A packmaster wears the teeth of every rival he has bested. Rynn wants five of those necklaces, to show the Dark Lady what the Peril has been chewing on.
quests.accept_text: From the packmasters. They wear the teeth on their necks. Don't pull too hard.
quests.turn_in_text: That's a lot of rivals. I want the one who gave them the idea.

quests.title: Bloodmaw the Alpha
quests.description: At the heart of the Peril lives Bloodmaw, a grey-muzzled alpha who has outlived every challenger. He wears a collar of wolf teeth and a scar down his flank, and he is the only reason the pack still holds.
quests.accept_text: At the den, deep in the hills. He isn't hiding. He's waiting.
quests.turn_in_text: A pack without an alpha scatters. We'll see how many come back. Thank you.

quests.title: Wallbreakers
quests.description: Worgen throw themselves at the Greymane Wall every night, and the dead of the wall rise to meet them. Corporal Teague wants the breakers thinned, and the ghosts calmed, if either can be done.
quests.accept_text: The long wall, along the southern edge. They come in waves. Meet them one at a time.
quests.turn_in_text: The wall holds. Another night. Thank you.

quests.title: Seals of the Greymane Guard
quests.description: The ghosts of the Wall Guard carry the seals they swore their oaths on. Teague wants five, to lay on the shut gate when the next Forsaken relief arrives.
quests.accept_text: From the wraiths. Iron seals, stamped with a lion. Handle gently.
quests.turn_in_text: They'll rest easier on the gate than on the dead. Thank you.

quests.title: The Shut Gate
quests.description: The great gate in the Greymane Wall has not opened since the night Gilneas shut itself off from the world. Teague wants someone to stand before it and report whether there's any sign of change.
quests.accept_text: The gate's in the middle of the wall. Don't touch it. Don't knock. Just look.
quests.turn_in_text: Not a hair of change. Good. I'd rather the thing stay closed than learn what's behind it.

quests.title: The Wall-Warden
quests.description: The ghost of the Wall's last commander still walks the parapet, enforcing a sentence that was never lifted: nothing in, nothing out. The Forsaken cannot pass him either. He has to be put down.
quests.accept_text: Along the parapet, by the gate. He challenges everyone. He means it.
quests.turn_in_text: He was doing his duty. I'm sorry it came to this. I'm sorry for all of us.

quests.title: Ghosts at the Mill
quests.description: Ambermill was a Dalaran lumber village until the plague took its mages. Their ghosts stayed behind, along with the wards they set on the mill. Millwright Haskell can't tell which are guarding the place, and which are guarding themselves.
quests.accept_text: The village and the mill-yard. The ghost-mages cast. The wardens hit.
quests.turn_in_text: Fewer ghosts, fewer wards. I might get a plank cut before dark.

quests.title: Resin of the Wardens
quests.description: The mill's wardens are made of amber resin, hardened by magic. Haskell wants six lumps. 'Fuel for the stove,' he says, and then admits it's for the stove he plans to build in a house that isn't there any more.
quests.accept_text: From the wardens. Warm to the touch. Don't lick them.
quests.turn_in_text: Six lumps. That's my winter. Thank you. Truly.

quests.title: The Old Waygate
quests.description: Magister Orsolo studied the Ambermill waygate for forty years. It leads somewhere, and he has finally decided he does not want to know where. He wants someone to stand at the gate and tell him what it looks like now.
quests.accept_text: East of the mill, below the cliff. Stand at its feet. Don't touch the runes.
quests.turn_in_text: Violet. Brighter than it was. So it's still listening. Thank you. I'll keep my distance.

quests.title: Magister Quillfire
quests.description: Orsolo's colleague, Magister Quillfire, never left the tower. Now he casts spells on anyone who nears it, and the waygate answers him. Orsolo cannot bring himself to do it, and asks that you do.
quests.accept_text: Near the waygate. He writes in the air. Don't read it.
quests.turn_in_text: He was a gentle man, and a better mage than I. I'm sorry it fell to you.

quests.title: Waterlogged Crew
quests.description: The ferry's crew drowned the night the boat went down, and walked back up the lake bed the next morning. They work the pier from dusk to dawn and will not let Gael sleep. He asks that you send them back.
quests.accept_text: On and around the pier. The deckhands hold the boat-hooks. The birds hold grudges.
quests.turn_in_text: A quieter dock. I may even sleep.

quests.title: Lost Cargo
quests.description: Cargo crates wash up on the shore at all hours, and the deckhands guard them as if they were gold. Dockhand Pim wants five of them, delivered to the Rear Guard. 'If it's gold,' she says, 'the Dark Lady should have it.'
quests.accept_text: Off the deckhands. They carry them as if by instinct. Five crates.
quests.turn_in_text: It's mostly rotten fish. But five of them sealed with Dalaran wax? Someone's lost something.

quests.title: A Ticket to Somewhere
quests.description: A ticket stub for the Decrepit Ferry, stamped with a date from the last winter before the plague. The destination is Fenris Isle. Gael may remember who it was sold to.

objectives.label: Bring the ticket stub to Ferryman Gael

quests.accept_text: The ferryman, at the pier. He keeps every stub.
quests.turn_in_text: Last passenger I carried to the isle. I never saw him come back.

quests.title: The Drowned Ferryman
quests.description: The first ferryman drowned with the boat, and rose to take it back. He steers at night, and his passengers are not the sort who pay. Gael wants him put in his grave.
quests.accept_text: On the pier head. He leans on his oar like it's holding him up.
quests.turn_in_text: He taught me the trade. He deserves a better ending than that. Thank you.

quests.title: The Crossing to Fenris
quests.description: With the old ferryman gone, Gael has agreed to take passengers to Fenris Isle again. He says he'll go as far as the pier head and no farther, and wants you to check the moorings.
quests.accept_text: The end of the pier. The boat'll take you across when you're ready.
quests.turn_in_text: Moorings hold. The lake's flat. The isle's waiting, if you've the stomach.

quests.title: Pickets at the Portcullis
quests.description: Ghouls and stalkers crowd the keep road, drawn by whatever Arugal keeps inside. Gatekeeper Marl wants the road clear before the next party goes in.
quests.accept_text: Near the gate. Ghouls on the road, stalkers in the trees.
quests.turn_in_text: A clear road. Whatever you're walking into, you'll walk in with fresh boots.

quests.title: The Keep's Forecourt
quests.description: Marl has stood at Shadowfang's gate for years and cannot say whether the howling has grown louder or he has grown used to it. He wants someone to stand in the forecourt and tell him honestly.
quests.accept_text: In front of the portcullis. Stand, listen, report.
quests.turn_in_text: Louder. I thought so. Gods help whoever's inside.

quests.title: The March's Reckoning
quests.description: Five reports lie on Dallow's table: the Deathguard Captain is down, the Bloated One is down, Lord Godfrey's Remnant is down, Berard rests, and Bloodmaw's pack has scattered. The March has not seen five victories in a row since the war.
quests.accept_text: Come back to Valgan's Field. Stand where the March can see you.
quests.turn_in_text: Five victories. A medal for each, if we had medals. Instead, take this. The March doesn't forget.

quests.title: The Road South
quests.description: Godfrey's remnant is dealt with and the Hearthwarden has run out of reasons to keep anyone in Silverpine. South of the pyre the pines thin out, the blight stops at a line you can stand on, and the road goes down into a valley that still grows things.
quests.accept_text:
Go south. Down the pass, past the last of the pines, and keep going until the ground changes colour.

There is a tower called Southpoint at the bottom of it with our banner on it, and a commander in it who is short of everything including people. You have done what there is to do here. Hillsbrad has not run out of work in living memory.
quests.turn_in_text:
You saw it, then. The green.

Everyone comes back up this road eventually and nobody ever describes it the same way twice. Go on - she needs you more than I do.

quests.title: Ashes to the Apothecary
quests.description: The Ashen Cult burned something in that hall that did not burn like wood, and the Hearthwarden has a phial of what was left. There is nobody in Silverpine qualified to tell her what it is. There is an apothecary at Southpoint Tower who has spent four years with nothing to work on but blight and would very likely open the phial in the road.

objectives.label: Carry the phial to Apothecary Jessel Vane at Southpoint Tower

quests.accept_text:
Sealed, and it stays sealed. South to Southpoint Tower in Hillsbrad - ask for Vane.

I will be plain: I do not know what is in it, which is precisely why it is going to someone who does. Do not open it to satisfy yourself on the road. People have.
quests.turn_in_text:
Silverpine pyre ash. In a sealed phial. For ME.

You have no idea how long it has been since anyone sent me a question instead of an order. Tell her it will take a week and that it will be worth the week.

on_accept.name: Sealed Phial of Pyre Ash
on_accept.description: Grey ash from the Ashen Cult's hall, sealed under wax. It is faintly warm, which ash a month old should not be.
